children: Infratil's investor day reinforced its growth outlook in the eyes of its bulls at Jarden. Analysts at the investment bank point to upgraded FY 2027 earnings guidance for the infrastructure investor's partially owned CDC data centers. They also think that the market might be undervaluing the near-term pipeline at U.S. renewable energy provider Longroad, which Infratil partially owns. The next catalyst for dual-listed Infratil will be the likely pricing of a US$750 million external capital raise at Longroad, they write in a note. Jarden keeps a buy rating on Infratil's New Zealand-listed stock with an unchanged target price of 18.63 New Zealand dollars. Shares closed 1.3% higher at NZ$14.28. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
